name: Lonnie
source:
"Stranger things will happen." 

Cheerful and friendly, Lonnie is one of the few people in wonderland willing to listen to you, albeit with some disbelief. He has been close friends with Chess for a long time and helps out around the inn. But under his bright facade, could he be hiding something?
